critique: The black field, hot pale-yellow core, orange edge color, and rightward temporal progression are now recognizable as a muzzle-flash-like event. At 0.08 there is a short orange tail feeding into a brighter head, which is more directional than prior renders. However, the effect remains far too small and reads as a compact glowing projectile/comet rather than the large explosive muzzle-flash wedge in the preset thumbnail. The bright head is rounded and soft, while the trail is thin and uniform; it needs a broader, sharper flame body with visibly larger, more irregular explosive energy.

suggestions.why: Increase primary particle scale so the flash occupies a more substantial area and its fire mass reads as an explosive muzzle flare rather than a tiny projectile.
Reduce excessive particle feathering to make the forward flame silhouette and bright core more defined, sharper, and closer to a flame wedge.
